two_way_audio.description:
Talk to people near your cameras and doorbells while you watch the live stream.

This works with cameras that support two-way audio and whose integration has added this capability. A talk button appears on the live stream when both conditions are met; if you don't see it for your camera, either the camera or its integration doesn't support two-way audio yet.
Two-way audio is currently only available when Home Assistant is opened over HTTPS, because browsers require a secure connection for microphone access. We're working on bringing it to the Home Assistant apps over HTTP as well.
two_way_audio.disable_confirmation: Two-way audio will be turned off for all cameras.
two_way_audio.enable_confirmation: This feature is still in development and may change. Two-way audio only works when Home Assistant is opened over HTTPS.
two_way_audio.name: Two-way audio
